title: Dusk hill: windmill, setting sun and passing bird (layered one-shot)

controls.name: --v2c-dusk-time-scale
controls.description: multiplies every animation duration and delay (1 = reference timing)

controls.name: --v2c-dusk-sky-top
controls.description: sky gradient colour at the top edge (y = 0)

controls.name: --v2c-dusk-sky-horizon
controls.description: sky gradient colour extrapolated to the stage bottom (y = 360); horizon glow

controls.name: --v2c-dusk-dusk-strength
controls.description: final alpha of the navy dusk overlay over sky and sun

controls.name: --v2c-dusk-sail-spin
controls.description: total clockwise sail rotation before the stop (use multiples of 90deg for an upright final cross)
